prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Offshore wind farm O&M; grid, port out of scope. Offshore Substation (Morrowick; Transformer Tap Snapshot→Shore Control Room; Switching Window Acknowledgment); Main Transformer; Grid Interface Relay (Wildmere; Export Limit Advisory→Grid Dispatcher if capability<target or changes; applies Dispatcher ceiling). Turbine Controller (Glassfin; validated commands; Pitch Deviation Notice; safe mode on aux loss; fire shutdown; keeps local protection if supervisory link lost), Pitch System, Rotor Brake Unit, Converter Cabinet, Nacelle Condition Monitor, Turbine Sensor Bus. Blade Inspection Drone (Larkspur; Leading Edge Tile Image). Export Cable Monitor (alarms→Control Engineer), Fire Detection Panel, Emergency Generator (Foxglove; auto start; Start Test Trace→Substation Operator); never bypassed. Helideck. Modes: Degraded (records function/condition/time; safety first; escalate), Substation Degraded, Grid Constraint, Weather Hold (Weather Service), Vessel Standby, Turbine Lockout (until assessed/authorized; no remote restart in fire). Recovery: cause bounded, operator confirms stable, checks before automatic; Control Engineer coordinates lifting restrictions, suspends unconfirmed remote commands; SCADA Engineer verifies status/alarms/feedback consistent across views; Duty Planner updates priorities/deferred work after confirmation; staged restoration; event record and decisions retained. Fleet Dispatch Console (Sable Orchard; status→Duty Planner). Alarms: safety>protection>export. SCADA Gateway (Juniper Vale; records→Shore Control Room; Session Revocation Receipt→Cybersecurity Gateway). Shore Control Room (Amber Quay; holds last limit; applies concept). Maintenance Planning Engine (Thistle Crown; Squall Window Bulletin; Deferred Task Rationale). Operations Radio Console (CTV, SOV, Daughter Craft). Personnel Tracking Console. Weather Analyst: Wave Burst Record; Visibility Confidence Note→Duty Planner. Marine Coordinator: Berth Slot Confirmation. Vessel Master: Transfer Manifest Addendum; Crew Count Correction→Personnel Tracking Console. Recovery Basket Load Sheet→Rescue Coordinator. HSE Officer: evacuation advice. Field Supervisor: work status→Shore Control Room. Warehouse System: failure data. North Access Scanner: gate secured if unverifiable; no verbal override. Southern scanner: logs; barrier closed on failure. Governance: asset operator assigns document owner (periodic and change-triggered review); changes need impact assessment (safety, marine, electrical, availability, cyber, regulatory); roles incl. Cybersecurity Analyst review;

New part:
S977: Review findings are assessed for their effect on existing procedures, training, interfaces, and resource requirements.
S978: Proposed revisions are checked by affected operational and technical representatives before submission to the designated approver.
S979: The approver confirms that comments are resolved or explicitly accepted before the revised baseline is released.
S980: Released revisions identify the change, rationale, approval, effective date, and superseded baseline.
S981: Personnel affected by a revision receive appropriate communication or training before the change takes effect.
S982: Unapproved local variations are not treated as changes to the operating concept and are escalated through established governance channels.
S983: The operator periodically evaluates whether assurance arrangements provide sufficient evidence that the concept remains effective.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
